meta.name: Raandhuni Na Kaanduni
meta.description: Hosted by Ankush Hazra, Raandhuni Na Kaandhuni brings together comedy, cooking and chaos in a fun-filled Bengali entertainment show. Watch popular Bengali personalities come together in the kitchen, where culinary skills meet hilarious challenges, unexpected moments and plenty of masti.

videos.title: Kacha Lonka vs Shukno Lonka
videos.overview: 12 participants, two mentors and one kitchen full of surprises! Ankush Hazra sets the stage as the contestants face their first tests before being divided into two rival teams. But just when they think they’re ready, a surprising challenge turns up the heat. Who will rise to the occasion and become the first winners?
